  "say": "I'll sketch a fish on the pad, tail fin's the giveaway. Shout if you'd rather have something else.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 5,
  "point": [25, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[25, 10], [21, 6.5], [15, 5.5], [9, 7], [5, 10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[25, 10], [21, 13.5], [15, 14.5], [9, 13], [5, 10]]},

    {"type": "line", "x0": 24.5, "y0": 12.5, "x1": 28.5, "y1": 15.5},
    {"type": "label", "x": 9, "y": 9, "text": "eye"},
    {"type": "label", "x": 25, "y": 10, "text": "START"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Holding the pad. Sketched a fish facing left: stroke 1 is the top outline from START at the tail to the nose, stroke 2 is the bottom outline branching from START, strokes 3 and 4 are the tail fin branching off the body near START. Next: trace stroke 1, then stroke 2, then fin strokes. Ask Maya/Priya/Leo to take a stroke each if they want to help."
